title: explorerComparison
responsibility: Compares the two sides of an entity's evidence: the scenarios covering a unit, their united entries and why the sides are not like for like.

inputs.name: covering.detail
inputs.description: The revision whose registry supplies the scenarios and units used for this lookup. A null revision produces an empty result.

inputs.name: covering.unit
inputs.description: The registry unit id matched against scenario unit lists and passed to state selection. It must use the unit id namespace, not a scenario, record, or commit id.

inputs.name: united.now
inputs.description: The first list is kept in its original order and is not deduplicated. Its ids determine which entries from the second list are skipped.

inputs.name: united.was
inputs.description: Entries with ids already present in the first list are skipped. Repeated ids that occur only in this list remain repeated.

inputs.name: merged.now
inputs.description: The current side’s scenario supplies the base object. It is returned as is when the other side is undefined; otherwise its states, viewports, and evidence are merged by id.

inputs.name: merged.was
inputs.description: The prior side’s declaration contributes states, viewports, and evidence whose ids are missing from the current scenario. Undefined means there is no prior declaration to merge.

inputs.name: explorerComparison.before
inputs.description: The earlier side supplies the record profile and revision detail used for comparison. Its scenarios are checked only against later scenarios with the same id.

inputs.name: explorerComparison.after
inputs.description: The later side supplies the record profile and revision detail used for comparison. Only matching earlier scenario ids can produce viewport or test differences.

inputs.name: explorerComparison.unit
inputs.description: The registry unit id whose covering scenarios are compared on both sides. Both revisions must use the same unit id for the comparison to refer to the same unit.

outputs.name: covering
outputs.description: The scenarios that cover the unit, with each scenario’s states selected by scenarioFor using the revision’s units. The result is empty for a null revision or when no scenario covers the unit.

outputs.name: united
outputs.description: All entries from the first list are followed by second-list entries whose ids do not occur in the first list. Repeated ids within either list are not removed.

outputs.name: merged
outputs.description: The current scenario is the base; when a prior scenario exists, states, viewports, and evidence are united by id, with missing evidence lists treated as empty. Other fields remain from the current scenario.

outputs.name: explorerComparison
outputs.description: The reasons can include differing truthy profiles, changed dimensions for matching viewport ids in matching scenarios, and tests whose JSON serialization differs. Added or removed scenario ids alone produce no reason.
examples: The two sides were recorded under different profiles (chromium-desktop and firefox-desktop).
Evidence grid: viewport desktop is 1024×768 before and 1280×800 after.
Evidence grid runs other tests after than before.
